# luno HCMS — Public API

> luno is a headless CMS built on Cloudflare Workers + PostgreSQL. The Public API requires no authentication. Base URL: https://{your-domain}/public/v1

## Key Facts

- No API key or token required for the Public API
- All responses are JSON (Content-Type: application/json)
- Pagination: `?page=1&limit=20` (max limit: 100)
- Responses include `ETag` for conditional requests (304 Not Modified)
- CORS: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` — call from any browser
- Cache-Control: `public, max-age=60` on content endpoints

## Content Model

luno organizes content as:

- **Form Set** — a content type (e.g., "blog", "news", "products")
- **Entry** — an individual piece of content with a URL-safe `slug`
- **Revision** — a version of an entry; only `published` revisions are returned

## Endpoints

### Content

- `GET /form-sets/{slug}` — Form set info + primary entry content (slug "main" preferred)
- `GET /form-sets/{slug}/entries` — Paginated list of published entries
- `GET /form-sets/{slug}/entries/{entry_slug}` — Single published entry (301 if slug changed)
- `GET /content/by-path?path=` — Look up by import path
- `GET /content/by-slug?formSetSlug=&slug=` — Look up by form set + entry slug
- `GET /content/by-external-id?sourceType=&entityType=&externalId=` — Look up by external ID

### Query Parameters (entries list)

- `page` (int, default 1) — page number
- `limit` (int, default 20, max 100) — items per page
- `offset` (int) — alternative to page
- `locale` (string) — filter localized field values (e.g., "ja", "en")
- `q` (string) — full-text search (Business plan+)
- `sort` (string) — sort key, e.g., "created_at:desc", "updated_at:asc"
- `include_snapshot` (boolean) — include field values and mediaUrls in list response

### Media

- `GET /media/{assetId}` — Serve uploaded media file (image, document, etc.)

### Preview

- `GET /preview/revisions?token=` — Fetch unpublished revision with signed JWT (15-min validity)

### SEO / Sitemap

- `GET /sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap for all published entries
- `GET /form-sets/{slug}/sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap for one form set
- `GET /form-sets/{slug}/entries/{slug}/schema.json` — schema.org JSON-LD
- `GET /form-sets/{slug}/entries/{slug}/ogp.json` — Open Graph Protocol metadata

### Contact Forms

- `POST /contact-forms/{slug}/submit` — Submit a contact form (JSON body)

### AI Reference

- `GET /llms.txt` — This file (short API summary)
- `GET /llms-full.txt` — Full API specification for AI agents

## Response Structure (Single Entry)

```json
{
  "formSet": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "blog", "name": "Blog" },
  "entry": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "my-post" },
  "revision": { "id": "uuid", "revision": 3, "updatedAt": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z" },
  "data": { "<field_key>": "<value>" },
  "mediaUrls": { "<field_key>": "https://{your-domain}/public/v1/media/<assetId>" },
  "widgetRoles": { "<field_key>": "title|thumbnail|description|..." }
}
```

The `data` object keys match field keys defined in the form set.

## Field Value Types

- text / textarea → string
- tiptap → string (HTML)
- number → number
- boolean → boolean
- date → string (ISO 8601)
- select / radio → string
- multiselect → string[]
- image / file → string (asset UUID; resolve via `mediaUrls[key]`)
- video_embed → string (URL)
- entry_ref → string (referenced entry slug)

## Error Format

```json
{ "error": { "code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "Published entry not found" } }
```

Common codes: `NOT_FOUND` (404), `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400), `PLAN_REQUIRED` (403), `UNAUTHORIZED` (401)

## Discovering Form Sets

The Public API has no form set list endpoint. Use these approaches:
1. Fetch `/public/v1/llms.txt` — lists available form sets when configured
2. Parse `/public/v1/sitemap.xml` — URL pattern reveals form set slugs
3. Ask the site administrator
